decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w3' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.953. Series context: trend strength 0.9252 and seasonal strength 0.0858; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.415); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 5.825.
